# nodes / vncshell

### `POST /nodes/{node}/vncshell`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).vncshell.$post()
```

Creates a VNC Shell proxy.

Returns `any`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `ceph_install` \| `login` \| `upgrade` |  | Run specific command or default to login (requires 'root@pam') — default `"login"` |
| `cmd-opts` | string |  | Add parameters to a command. Encoded as null terminated strings. — default `""` |
| `height` | number |  | sets the height of the console in pixels. — min 16, max 2160 |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `websocket` | boolean |  | use websocket instead of standard vnc. |
| `width` | number |  | sets the width of the console in pixels. — min 16, max 4096 |
